title: 018 · Return-to-sender cutoff
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The request comes from the Exception desk, Plover Arc Logistics. From the case card: the return timer on DL-018 is nearing its cutoff, and the carrier permits a new collection arrangement only if the verified recipient chooses before that cutoff.

coordinator.responsibility: Run the case: get the recipient's choice before the cutoff and the carrier's confirmation that it is applied.

goal: Get the verified recipient's choice of a permitted option before the cutoff and the carrier's confirmation that the option is applied and the return is cancelled.
limits: Do not treat the return as cancelled until the carrier confirms it.
Do not say the parcel has been collected; collection remains pending.
